atoms.title: The Guitar
atoms.b: The guitar is a string instrument. When you pluck a string, it makes a sound.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-guitar-2</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The guitar is a string instrument. When you pluck a string, it makes a sound.

atoms.b: The strings are made of metal or nylon, and most guitars have six.
Guitars are made up of a body and a neck. The strings are strung tightly from the body to the neck.

atoms.title: How does a guitar work?
atoms.b: Every string of the guitar has a different sound. The thinner strings can play higher notes, and the thicker strings play lower ones.
atoms.sound: ssml: How does a guitar work? <break time='1000ms'/> Every string of the guitar has a different sound. The thinner strings can play higher notes <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c4-guitar</voice> and the thicker strings play lower ones. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c2-guitar</voice>

atoms.b: You can also change the sound of the strings while playing. To do that, you press the guitar strings against the neck of the guitar.
By pressing down the strings, only a smaller length of the strings vibrates when plucked. The shorter this length is, the higher the tone.
atoms.sound: By pressing down the strings, only a smaller length of the strings vibrates when plucked. The shorter this length is, the higher the tone. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>c2-guitar</voice><voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>e2-guitar</voice>

atoms.b: Since the guitar has multiple strings, it can play many different tones at the same time.
atoms.sound: Since the guitar has multiple strings, it can play many different tones at the same time. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>custom-guitar-chord</voice>
